query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!: i64", COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.holder = ? AND e.start_position >= 0 AND f.position > e.start_position AND f.position <= COALESCE((SELECT next.start_position FROM writer_epochs next WHERE next.epoch > e.epoch ORDER BY next.epoch LIMIT 1), ?) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 0) AS "invalid!: i64" FROM project_feed f LEFT JOIN writer_epochs e ON e.epoch = f.epoch WHERE f.position > ? AND f.position <= ?
